create_sample: create a Sample object from a dictionary with torch tensor values for MMF dataset
create_samplelist: create a SampleList by collating a list of Sample objects into a batched tensor structure
move_samplelist_to_device: move a SampleList and all its tensor fields to a specified device like cuda or cpu
convert_batch_to_samplelist: convert a batch dictionary or list into a SampleList for use with MMF models
detach_samplelist_tensors: detach all tensor fields in a SampleList to remove them from the computation graph
